text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While I'm walking around the academy
at night, I
notice a fragrant aroma
wafting toward me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before long, I recognize it as the smell
of coffee.
Upon investigating, I realize
it's coming from
Manhattan Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I know. I'm just finishing up my drink
before I
head back.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I came across some decent Guatemala
full city
roast that piqued my interest...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
And I just really felt like enjoying its
aroma today.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No. It calms me and makes sleeping
easier.
Coffee affects people
differently...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I find it more relaxing to drink at night.
It lets me
take the time to savor it...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I come here when I want to relax...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's easier for me to focus in the dark. I
feel more
attuned to scents and flavors...
temperatures and
sounds.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
When my senses are sharpened, coffee
tastes
more delicious.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
And it's easier both to think... and not to
think in
the dark.
